newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT-JGBs seen heading lower, eyes on Nikkei.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-JGBs seen heading lower, eyes on Nikkei.

text.p: Japanese government bonds (JGBs) are likely to test the downside during Tokyo trade as book-squaring sales emerge, with negative technical factors also likely to encourage sales, traders said.
A key factor for the day will be movements in the Nikkei stock index, which on Tuesday finished at 19,514.45, although weakness there may be offset by a gradually strengthening dollar.
Investor buying at lows will also be closely watched.
But traders said technical factors were likely to spur sales should the key contract touch 126.30.
